page0.text:
A breeze enters the damp room.
Two sets of footsteps come from the opened door.
One is a hurried stomping, while the other sounds like it's being pulled along.

page1.text:
"Come on. It's ready."
There's a thud.
The noise echoes through the dark, hidden room.
Shinji Matou pushes the other person he roughly dragged into the room.

page2.text:
Something is slithering and squirming on the floor.
Shinji Matou knows what they are.
They're the mysterious, vile creatures that his grandfather Zouken Matou has been breeding.

page3.text: Shinji pushes someone into the room full of them.

page7.text:
"There we go. Let's finish this quickly."
He speaks from atop the stairs.
The chamber is full of the creatures' musk. The moment any normal person steps foot into this room, they would be overcome by terror.

page8.text:
But this person is an exception.
The things shy away from the figure who just entered.
Are they afraid, or just sick of its presence?
The unseen monsters refuse to approach.
They writhe and tremble in a perimeter around the figure.

page9.text:
"Make me a new book. You still have two left, don't you?"
The presence reacts to Shinji's voice.
It creaks and scratches.
The darkness billows and rolls, as if eager to carry out the order.

page10.text:
"Do what I say, then you can go back. That's what you want, don't you?"
There's no answer.
Only the ear-grating chittering of the bugs fills the room.

page11.text:
"Listen. We'll have to fight him sooner or later. If you keep being selfish..."
"Then you're the one who will have to fight him," Shinji finishes.
The figure trembles.
It can't do that.
The old man whom Shinji calls his teacher won't allow it.

page12.text:
But the figure knows that Shinji doesn't always follow his teacher's directions.
Right now, he's filled with hatred for Shirou Emiya.
His mind has long since lost any patience for rejection.
The old man is keeping him away from the conflict for his own safety, but to Shinji, it's an unacceptable humiliation.

page13.text:
"......"
After a long silence, a change occurs in the room.
Another figure appears in a flash of light.
The creatures' presence is driven from the room by her appearance.
Even these vermin of low intelligence know to fear her enormous, monstrous aura.

page14.text:
"Good. You can leave everything else to me."
Her body is slender and supple. Her hair, long enough to reach the floor.
Clad in a single black garment, she is the Servant Rider.

page15.text:
"Let me ask you a question, Shinji.
Will you only use me to protect yourself?"
In the depths of the chamber,
gazing up from the bottom of the pen, the dark Servant inquires.

page16.text:
"Yeah. I need you to keep me safe if anything crazy happens."
Shinji, a Master once again, fails to contain his delight. He's so ecstatic that he blurts out an answer which can only be a lie.
